=-- Open a run-log row. '{{ $('Run by hand').isExecuted ? 'manual' : 'schedule' }}' = 'schedule' | 'manual'.
INSERT INTO runs (trigger) VALUES ('{{ $('Run by hand').isExecuted ? 'manual' : 'schedule' }}') RETURNING id;

-- Onboarded users with their keywords, followed author and the papers already shown to them in EARLIER weeks
-- (this week's are left out, so re-running the same week rebuilds the same report).
SELECT u.id, u.email, u.name, u.lab_name,
       coalesce((SELECT array_agg(k.term ORDER BY k.position) FROM keywords k WHERE k.user_id = u.id), '{}') AS keywords,
       (SELECT jsonb_build_object('openalex_id', a.openalex_id, 'display_name', a.display_name, 'institution', a.institution)
          FROM followed_authors a WHERE a.user_id = u.id ORDER BY a.confirmed_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS author,
       coalesce((SELECT array_agg(s.work_id) FROM seen_papers s
                  WHERE s.user_id = u.id
                    AND s.first_seen_week < date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date), '{}') AS seen
FROM users u
WHERE u.onboarded_at IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY u.id;

=-- Save every successful report (a report already emailed keeps its emailed_at), remember the shown papers,
-- and close the run log. $pr${{ JSON.stringify($input.all().map(i => i.json)) }}$pr$ = JSON array of "Summarize + render" items, {{ $('Start run').first().json.id }} = id from start_run.sql.
WITH input AS (
    SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($pr${{ JSON.stringify($input.all().map(i => i.json)) }}$pr$::jsonb)
        AS x(user_id bigint, ok boolean, data jsonb, new_ids jsonb, markdown text, email_html text, error text)
), saved AS (
    INSERT INTO reports (user_id, week_start, run_id, data, markdown, email_html)
    SELECT user_id, (data->>'week')::date, {{ $('Start run').first().json.id }}, data, markdown, email_html FROM input WHERE ok
    ON CONFLICT (user_id, week_start) DO UPDATE SET
        run_id = EXCLUDED.run_id, data = EXCLUDED.data, markdown = EXCLUDED.markdown,
        email_html = EXCLUDED.email_html, updated_at = now()
    RETURNING user_id
), seen AS (
    INSERT INTO seen_papers (user_id, work_id, first_seen_week)
    SELECT i.user_id, w.id, (i.data->>'week')::date
    FROM input i, jsonb_array_elements_text(i.new_ids) AS w(id)
    WHERE i.ok
    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
), counts AS (
    SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM saved) AS ok_n,
           (SELECT count(*) FROM input WHERE NOT ok) AS failed_n,
           (SELECT string_agg('user ' || user_id || ': ' || error, E'\n') FROM input WHERE NOT ok) AS errors
)
UPDATE runs SET finished_at = now(), users_ok = c.ok_n, users_failed = c.failed_n, error = c.errors,
       status = CASE WHEN c.failed_n = 0 THEN 'success' WHEN c.ok_n > 0 THEN 'partial' ELSE 'failed' END
FROM counts c
WHERE runs.id = {{ $('Start run').first().json.id }}
RETURNING runs.*;

-- This week's reports not emailed yet, for users who have email turned on.
SELECT r.id, r.week_start::text AS week_start, r.email_html, u.email, u.name
FROM reports r JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id
WHERE r.emailed_at IS NULL AND u.email_enabled
  AND r.week_start = date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date
ORDER BY r.id;
